# Concept Map: Trigonometry

* **Interconnected Toolkit:** Trigonometric concepts build upon each other.
* **Data-Informed Priority:** The map below highlights ten core concepts.

::: {.mindmap-container}

::: {.mindmap-canvas}
```{r}
#| label: concept-mindmap
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(visNetwork)

nodes <- data.frame(
  id = 1:10,
  label = c("1. Restricted-Domain Equations", "2. Compound Angles", "3. Double Angles", 
            "4. Auxiliary Angle", "5. t-formula", "6. Inverse Trig Definitions", 
            "7. Inverse Trig Graphs", "8. Trig Calculus", "9. Trig Modelling", "10. Exact-Value Fluency"),
  value = c(94, 7, 18, 30, 9, 78, 26, 55, 84, 34),
  group = c("Year 11", "Year 11", "Year 11", "Year 11", "Year 11", 
            "Year 12", "Year 12", "Year 12", "Cross-topic", "Foundational"),
  stats = c(
    "<b>Score:</b> 94%<br><b>Risk:</b> High (1.00)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 7%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.00)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 18%<br><b>Risk:</b> Med (0.44)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 30%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.29)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 9%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.00)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 78%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.29)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 26%<br><b>Risk:</b> Med (0.44)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 55%<br><b>Risk:</b> Med (0.51)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 84%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.20)",
    "<b>Score:</b> 34%<br><b>Risk:</b> Low (0.09)"
  )
)

edges <- data.frame(
  from = c(10, 10, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6, 7, 8),
  to   = c(1, 6, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 7, 8, 8, 9)
)

visNetwork(nodes, edges, width = "100%", height = "550px") %>%
  visNodes(font = list(size = 18, face = "Segoe UI")) %>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = FALSE) %>%
  visPhysics(solver = "forceAtlas2Based") %>%
  visEvents(click = "function(properties) {
    var callout = document.getElementById('concept-callout');
    if (properties.nodes.length == 1) {
      var nodeId = properties.nodes[0];
      var node = this.body.data.nodes.get(nodeId);
      callout.innerHTML = '<h3>' + node.label + '</h3><p>' + node.stats + '</p>';
    } else {
      callout.innerHTML = '<h3>Concept Details</h3><p>Click a node in the mindmap to view its HSC ranking statistics.</p>';
    }
  }")
```
